sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
"Fields of bodies, Mountains of dead
Down Dragonspring river, our country bled
A fiery god, demon wolf in red"
-Memory of Shura

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Shura (修羅 Carnage) is what those who go on killing eventually become. They don't remember why, but they are simply enraptured and kill solely for the joy it brings them.
